candidate.subject: government
candidate.question: A Constitution is a legal document

options.C: forming the basis upon which a government rules the country
options.D: which must not be altered by any succeeding government
options.E: only likely to succeed in a country where there is union government

candidate.explanation: A constitution sets the fundamental rules through which government is organized and exercises authority. It defines institutions, powers and limits; it is not defined by who drafted it or by an absolute ban on amendment.
